purpose: Prepare and flush complete quick-entry prologue bytes off-target before exclusive ART suspension; the paused patchCode callback only copies prepared bytes and finalizes I-cache synchronization. Restore uses the same publication protocol and retains retired trampoline owners/slices until script end. No live literal placeholder, JNI or writer generation during suspension; existing architecture/relocation choices remain. Before restoring, skip an identifiable later owner and retain trampolines. Commit errors attempt prepared rollback inside the same suspension. A failed shared bootstrap is sticky until target-process recreation, so partial success cannot be reported as complete. Also covers original ARM/ARM64 inlined OatQuickMethodHeader redirects and InlineHook restoration. Trampoline construction remains private/unpublished; semantic scan/relocation/register selection is unchanged.
